For [dataframe](/docs/shell/commands/categories/dataframe/).

<div class='command-title'>Gets weekday from date.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars get-weekday` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars get-weekday {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input             | output            |
| ----------------- | ----------------- |
| polars_dataframe  | polars_dataframe  |
| polars_lazyframe  | polars_lazyframe  |
| polars_expression | polars_expression |
| polars_selector   | polars_expression |
## Examples

Returns weekday from a date
```nu
> let dt = ('2020-08-04T16:39:18+00:00' | into datetime --timezone 'UTC');
    let df = ([$dt $dt] | polars into-df);
    $df | polars get-weekday
╭───┬───╮
│ # │ 0 │
├───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 2 │
│ 1 │ 2 │
╰───┴───╯

```

Returns weekday from a date
```nu
> let dt = ('2020-08-04T16:39:18+00:00' | into datetime --timezone 'UTC');
    let df = ([$dt $dt] | polars into-df);
    $df | polars select (polars col 0 | polars get-weekday)
╭───┬───╮
│ # │ 0 │
├───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 2 │
│ 1 │ 2 │
╰───┴───╯

```
